title: Ops: Review a reported cloud reset and personal test residue
body:
## Scope

One-time private operational review of a reported cloud reset and possible test residue. This is separate from product repair behavior (#515) and is not an M7 release gate. Exact account history, paths, timestamps, inventories and credentials remain in a restricted local record, not this issue.

Maintainer requirement (verbatim excerpt):
> this is unique to me and not some sort of cleanup process we need to build.

Read-only verification is requested. Cleanup is later: prepare a concrete private per-path proposal and obtain named action authorization before any change. Do not assume unfamiliar metadata or recovery copies are disposable.

## Work in order

1. Establish the reported reset instant and timezone privately and compare it with retained change records. Distinguish provider reset history from ordinary file modification times.
2. Read current selected device paths/activity and scoped remote metadata using an authorized route. Distinguish failed/unreadable listings from confirmed absence; avoid payload downloads or triggering sync.
3. Trace the reported metadata/recovery-file types to current writers/readers. Classify exact objects privately as active, recoverable unique data, proven test residue or uncertain. Preserve conflicting and uncertain copies.
4. Prepare a private keep/remove/review manifest and a redacted outcome. Any execution requires a separate exact action scope; no generic tidier, automated migration or product accommodation is part of this task.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A restricted timeline compares normalized reset/change instants and records clock/access limits; the issue exposes only a redacted conclusion, not account history.
- [ ] Read-only receipts establish selected paths/activity and scoped remote state or explicitly name unresolved access; no state-changing operation or credential disclosure occurs.
- [ ] A source-cited classification explains the reported file types and privately distinguishes recovery value from proven test residue; uncertain entries remain protected.
- [ ] A private per-path proposal and redacted summary state what would be kept/removed and why. No cleanup is claimed without exact authorization and outcome proof. The task stays outside M7 and #515's product implementation.

Can this be done on the VM? Product semantics can be inspected from source and synthetic examples. The requested observation concerns existing private state, which a synthetic VM cannot establish; it is operational verification, not device QA or release acceptance. Reads follow docs/device-testing-policy.md and private-output controls. No physical mutation is needed.

## Redacted progress

Read-only device clock/selected-state/activity, scoped category metadata and bounded orientation-record observations completed. Exact results and provisional per-path dispositions are in the restricted local review record. Source tracing distinguishes active metadata semantics from legacy records and recovery copies; no unfamiliar item is assumed to be test residue. The reported reset cutoff still needs date/timezone clarification. Full content integrity, exhaustive residue classification and any cleanup remain unclaimed; no cloud/device mutation or secret export occurred.
